caption: Polarization is the orientation of the electric field. On line-of-sight paths, cross-polarized antennas weaken the signal; on skywave paths the ionosphere scrambles polarization, so either antenna orientation works.
spoken: This figure shows vertical and horizontal antenna polarization. On a line-of-sight path, matching antennas give a strong signal and cross-polarized antennas a weak one; on a skywave path the ionosphere scrambles the polarization, so either antenna orientation works.
